ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:20 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black region covering >90% of the fluke area. Discrete high-contrast white focal spots (<15 pixels) are distributed primarily along the sub-marginal zones of the trailing edge and medial lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior angle of 115 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to the lobe peaks of approximately 15% of total vertical fluke visibility.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations across the entire visible boundary. Macro-notches are interspersed with micro-serrations, showing pixel-amplitudes of 5 to 30 pixels from the baseline edge curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical convex curve; both lobes exhibit a tapering upward and outward sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially clustered circular white pixel groups (3-10 pixel diameter) concentrated on the medial-posterior region of the right lobe and the upper-mid section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel white linear marks (rake patterns) detected on the superior margin of the right lobe; individual diagonal linear disruptions visible on the upper quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dense, high-contrast, multi-layered cluster of brownish-white pixels (sessile barnacle colonization) is attached to the extreme lateral tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Biological encrustation on the distal left margin creates a unique non-linear geometric protrusion that deviates from the smooth natural curve of the lobe tip.
